zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.title: 关于使用生成式人工智能的声明
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.subtitle: 透明使用 · 保护创作 · 尊重选择
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.models: 原木社区的所有 AI 辅助功能均使用市场上已有的模型提供服务。AI 是阅读与创作的辅助工具，不替代创作者的表达、判断与责任。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.promiseTitle: 用户资产绝不用于模型训练
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.promise: 我们承诺：用户的作品、草稿、设定、图片、提示词、对话记录及其他相关资产，绝不会被用于任何形式的模型训练、微调、蒸馏或训练数据集构建；也不会被出售、共享或授权第三方用于模型训练。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.expand: 阅读完整声明与使用原则
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.settings: 管理 AI 使用偏好
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.data.tit: 必要的推理传输与数据最小化
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.data.bod: 为完成问答、纠错、图像生成或内容检索，系统可能向模型服务提供方发送所需的内容与上下文。这些处理用于服务推理或检索，不代表授权任何主体将内容用于模型训练。请勿提交密码、他人的敏感信息或你无权提供的内容。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.provider: 第三方模型服务同样遵守不训练承诺
不训练承诺同样适用于第三方模型服务。模型服务的接入与使用须以禁止利用用户资产训练模型的数据条款和使用设置为前提；不得以改进模型、优化算法等名义绕过这一承诺。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.rights.b: 使用 AI 辅助不改变你已有作品及相关资产的权益归属。AI 输出不保证独创性或排他性；请核实是否过度复现他人作品，不将洗稿、冒用身份或侵犯他人权益的内容当作原创发布。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.reliabil: AI 可能产生事实错误、偏见或不恰当的表达，输出仅供辅助参考，不应被视为已核实的事实或专业意见。重要内容应由人审核；对外发布实质性 AI 生成的内容时，应说明 AI 的参与，避免误导读者。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.safety.t: 安全、公平与负责任使用
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.safety.b: 请遵守社区规则，不利用生成式 AI 制作欺骗、骚扰、仇恨、歧视、侵犯隐私或其他有害内容，不伪造他人身份或散布虚假信息。尊重不同群体与观点，审慎对待模型可能存在的偏见。
zh.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.choice.b: AI 辅助不是使用原木社区的必要条件。你可在“设置”中开启“禁用人工智能辅助”，隐藏红石中心和 AI 功能入口，普通阅读、写作与发布不受影响。如发现输出错误、安全风险或权益问题，可通过应用内反馈中心提出反馈。

en.redstone.aiDeclaration.title: Statement on the use of generative AI
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.subtitle: Transparency · Creative rights · User choice
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.models: All AI assistance features in LogHome use models already available on the market. AI supports reading and writing; it does not replace a creator's expression, judgment, or responsibility.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.promiseTitle: User assets are never used for model training
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.promise: Our commitment: users' works, drafts, settings, images, prompts, conversations, and other related assets will never be used for any form of model training, fine-tuning, distillation, or training dataset creation. They will not be sold, shared, or licensed to third parties for model training.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.expand: Read the full statement and principles
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.data.tit: Necessary inference transfers and data minimization
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.data.bod: To provide answers, corrections, image generation, or content retrieval, the system may send necessary content and context to model service providers. This processing supports inference or retrieval and does not authorize any party to use the content for model training. Do not submit passwords, others' sensitive information, or content you are not entitled to provide.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.provider: Third-party model services share the no-training commitment

The no-training commitment also applies to third-party model services. Integration and use must be conditional on data terms and usage settings that prohibit training models on user assets. Model improvement or algorithm optimization must not be used to circumvent this commitment.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.rights.t: Respect for originality and content rights
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.rights.b: Using AI assistance does not change your existing rights in your works and related assets. AI output is not guaranteed to be original or exclusive. Check for excessive reproduction of others' works, and do not present plagiarism, impersonation, or content that violates others' rights as original work.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.reliabil: AI can produce factual errors, bias, or inappropriate language. Its output is assistance, not verified fact or professional advice. Important content should be reviewed by a person. When publishing substantially AI-generated content, disclose AI's involvement to avoid misleading readers.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.safety.b: Follow community rules. Do not use generative AI to create deceptive, harassing, hateful, discriminatory, privacy-invading, or otherwise harmful content, impersonate others, or spread false information. Respect diverse groups and viewpoints, and remain alert to potential model bias.
en.redstone.aiDeclaration.sections.choice.b: AI assistance is not required to use LogHome. In Settings, you can turn on Disable AI assistance to hide Redstone Center and AI entry points without affecting ordinary reading, writing, or publishing. Report output errors, safety risks, or rights concerns through the in-app feedback center.
